a5c7ce1574be2829e4f5213fe62029c86dd7542d.sourceText:
| 用法 | 说明 | 何时使用 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `for (auto x : c)` | 值拷贝遍历 | 元素类型小（int/double 等） |
| `for (const auto& x : c)` | 只读引用遍历 | **最常用**，不想拷贝大对象 |
| `for (auto& x : c)` | 可修改引用遍历 | 需要修改容器中元素 |
| `for (int x : {1, 2, 3})` | 遍历初始值列表 | 快速遍历已知小集合 |
a5c7ce1574be2829e4f5213fe62029c86dd7542d.translatedText:
| Usage | Description | When to use |
|:---|:---|:---|
| `for (auto x : c)` | Value copy traversal | Element type is small (int/double etc\.) |
| `for (const auto& x : c)` | Read\-only reference traversal | **Most commonly used**do not want to copy large objects |
| `for (auto& x : c)` | Modifiable reference traversal | Need to modify elements in the container |
| `for (int x : {1, 2, 3})` | Traverse initializer list | Quickly traverse a known small collection |
